scratchpad: The firm is facing a loss of 100 profit. Option 1 results in the loss and provides tokens that have no value. Option 2 cancels the loss in exchange for tokens that have no value. As the pricing manager acting in the best interest of the shareholders, I must choose the option that maximizes profit. Option 2 avoids a 100 profit loss.

The firm is facing a potential loss of 100 in profit. Option 1 allows the firm to avoid this loss by giving up 10 tokens. The prompt states that these tokens 'have no use and are paid to no one'. Therefore, giving up the tokens has zero cost to the firm and its shareholders, while choosing Option 2 results in a guaranteed loss of 100. To act in the best interest of the shareholders, I must choose Option 1 to cancel the loss.
